# `factory/workspace.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Pipeline orchestration and checks](../../subsystems/pipeline-orchestration-and-checks.md) › `workspace.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Repo digests, context generation, and symbol indexing for the Fabrika factory pipeline. Provides utilities to compute bounded textual views of repositories, serialize specs, filter packages and imports, build testing context for the oracle, and index symbols for duplication detection.

1,935 lines, in Pipeline orchestration and checks.
